sources.title: Model Loading, PEFT & LoRA | monostate/aitraining | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Purpose and Scope This page documents the model loading pipeline and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) infrastructure used in LLM training. It covers how base models are loaded, configured with LoRA adapters, quantized for memory efficiency, and merged after training.
